# Vietnamese font source

These 16 font files were taken without modification from `kobo-tieng-viet` 1.0.0 by Lê Linh Tịnh:

<https://github.com/lelinhtinh/kobo-tieng-viet>

The project replaces Kobo's Avenir, Georgia, Rakuten Sans, and Rakuten Serif system fonts with font files that contain Vietnamese glyphs. This installer preserves the original filenames and device destinations.

See the upstream project for its font-generation notes and source references.
